notes: own site (paranaempanadas.com) blocked by the same sgcaptcha wall as Finca. DoorDash store address (4545 La Jolla Village Dr) matches the batch record exactly. JSON-LD embedded 5x (some as 'Most Ordered' carousel duplicates of the same items); deduped on name+price. Grubhub's independent listing for the same UTC location shows matching $4.18 empanada prices, corroborating. Full catalog is small (counter-style empanada shop): 10 empanada flavors + dessert + 2 jarred items + 5 drinks, all round/quarter-dollar pricing, plausible for 2026.
